title: Manage all your Apps And Updates in Admin Center for Business Central

chapters.title: Accessing Admin Center and viewing environments
All apps view and update availability
Action required vs install update status
Installing new apps from Admin Center
Future of app management in Admin Center

features.name: All apps view with update actions
features.description: The all apps view in Admin Center now includes the update action directly, previously requiring selection of global apps to update applications.
caveats: View includes both publishable and non-publishable apps
Sorting may be by app ID

features.name: Action required status for dependent apps
features.description: Updates show action required status when an app has dependencies on other apps that need updating first, indicating a dependency chain that must be resolved.
caveats: User must acknowledge app provider's terms and privacy policy before updating dependencies

features.name: Installation scheduling options
features.description: Users can schedule app installations with multiple timing options: right now, next update window (tonight), next minor, or next major version.

features.name: App installation from Admin Center
features.description: Users can install new apps directly from Admin Center without going to extension management, choosing installation timing and sync mode options.

features.name: Operations page for installation monitoring
features.description: The Operations page displays real-time progress of app installations, showing status and allowing users to monitor what is happening during the installation process.
caveats: Installation times vary; typical PTE installation takes around 1 minute 20 seconds

features.name: Uninstall apps from Admin Center
features.description: Users can uninstall both PTE and regular apps directly from the Admin Center interface.
